summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's speech:

The child reported that they have been attending a teen group and trying to step out of their comfort zone by interacting with new people, but stuttering is more noticeable when talking to people they don't know. They mentioned that stuttering is easier in comfortable situations with people they know, but harder during presentations or with new people. The child also shared that speech therapy helped them by allowing them to talk freely and find solutions to make situations better, and they recommended that speech therapists give them time to talk and listen without being forceful with tools.
